title: The agent's own site checks of a client-send demo count as check rounds and repairs on /ops/wo and in Details
steps: S1: in a client-send demo, the agent runs three counted checks: a failing one, a failing one started with check.start, then a passing one.
S2: read the build's qa and demoProgress of the build.
expect: S2: qa.rounds has 3 rounds with 1, 1 and 0 failed checks; qa.repairs is 2.
S2: demoProgress reports state needs-review, 3 rounds, 0 issues.
evidence: e2e dev 24/10/2026: /ops/wo showed 0 repairs and Details showed Site check rounds: 0 after three checks
fence: saveCheck records each client check in qa.rounds and qa.repairs, the fields every reader counts

tests: client-send reserves real chat and one native user request before provision; agent tools own install/check and server prompt stays zero
